english:
Class Ability usage while within 15 meters of an enemy grants Grenade, Melee, Class Ability, and Super Energy.

Energy Gains:
• Ability Energy: <pve 4% /> <pvp [2%] /> | <pve 6% /> <pvp [3%] /> | <pve 7% /> <pvp [3.5%] />
• Super Energy: <pve 2% /> <pvp [1%] /> | <pve 3% /> <pvp [1.5%] /> | <pve 4% /> <pvp [2%] />

Energy gains scale by class: 1x for <hunter/>Hunters, 1.2x for <titan/>Titans, and 2x for <warlock/>Warlocks.

#ChunkEnergyScalars (Super Energy gains are unaffected)

source.text:
On Class Ability Usage while within 15 metres of an enemy:
Grants Grenade, Melee, Class, and Super Energy.

4% | 6% | 7% Grenade, Melee and Class Energy
2% | 3% | 4% Super Energy

2% | 3% | 3.5% Grenade, Melee and Class Energy
1% | 1.5% | 2% Super Energy

 Energy Multipliers based on Class:
Hunters: x1 | Titans: x1.2 | Warlocks: x2
